fields.label: Location
fields.note: Free-text location on the guest search; pair it with the matching geoId (e.g. Bengaluru geoId=90009633, India geoId=102713980).

notes: Official careers page publishes LinkedIn job-search links filtered by company ids (f_C), location, geoId and sortBy=R; the worldwide listing with f_C=2587638,39939,1337 currently advertises 303 open roles. The guest endpoint /jobs-guest/jobs/api/seeMoreJobPostings/search accepts f_C, keywords, location, geoId, sortBy and start; a live request with f_C=1337&keywords=engineer&location=India&geoId=102713980&sortBy=R returned 10 LinkedIn company cards, confirming the keyword/location/sort parameters. Workplace and employment-type facets were not tested and are not documented here.
